$comment: Play advanced (docs/DEV_TOOLS.md, Play advanced): the main menu's alternate Play, opening a one-off local world by link (?local=1) with these overrides. Each entry is one URL parameter the game already reads; the menu shows a field per entry, in order, and passes only the fields the player set. Nothing is saved: the overrides leave the address when the player goes anywhere else. Kinds: choice (options, each a value and a label; or optionsFrom, the names in a look data file: outline or pixelart), integer (min, max), number (min, max, step), clock (a 24-hour time, passed as the share of the day: 0 midnight, 0.5 noon). A field left empty (or a choice's "" option) passes nothing, and the game's default stands. Run `node shared/play/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if client/src/ui/playOverrides.gen.ts is stale.

overrides.label: Spawn
overrides.hint: Each spawn is its own world file, so the others are untouched.

overrides.label: Time of day
overrides.hint: The sky stays at this time (the clock stops). Face A's clock; face B's is 12 hours on.

overrides.label: Clock speed
overrides.hint: 1 is normal; 60 makes a minute an hour. Only without a time of day.
